verdict.rationale: Browser Use publishes a documented public API: an OpenAPI 3.1 spec titled "Browser Use Public API v4", served at api.browser-use.com/api/v4 and secured by an API key header, with operations like create_run. SDK docs cover the core agent loop through the API: creating runs, multi-run sessions, cursor-based event polling and structured output. The probe's 404s hit generic paths only; the spec is linked from llms.txt at /cloud/openapi/v4.json, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the public API in practice.
